title: First measured GPU energy authority (IOReport, unprivileged)

measurement.integration: IOReport cumulative GPU Energy counter delta (mJ→J)
measurement.boundary: IOReport Energy Model channel 'GPU Energy' (AGX on-chip GPU domain only). Not package energy (CPU/DRAM/ANE excluded). Not wall-plug / PSU energy.
measurement.measures: AGX GPU Energy counter (integrated mJ over the sample window)
measurement.excludes: CPU cores/clusters, DRAM, GPU SRAM, ANE, display, PCIe, package total, wall AC draw, power-supply inefficiency
error_notes: Sampling interval 200 ms; sub-interval power spikes are averaged into each sample.
Joules for the load window are the cumulative counter delta, not mean(watts)*time.
Idle and load windows are sequential, not simultaneous — ambient GPU work from other processes is included.
GPU-alone energy is a lower bound on package energy and is not comparable to wall-plug joules.

The load window covers the entire llama-cli process, including model load / Metal graph compile, not decode-only steady state. Mean watts is therefore diluted by cold-start; peak watts and raw samples show the under-load signal.
What this number excludes: CPU cores/clusters, DRAM, ANE, display, package total, wall AC, PSU inefficiency — typically a large fraction of machine draw under mixed load.

cmd: Write a detailed technical essay about measuring GPU energy on Apple Silicon using IOReport. Cover channels, units, sampling, and the difference between GPU-domain and wall-plug energy.

signal_check.note: ratio must move under load; a flat signal is not authority

not_production_pricing_truth: This receipt is measured GPU-domain energy for one host and one workload. It does not replace sustainedWattsByHWClass and must not be written into control/pricing.go without a separate pricing lane.

vs_assumed_sustained_watts.assumed_source: control/pricing.go sustainedWattsByHWClass (not edited by this lane)
vs_assumed_sustained_watts.comparison_caveat: The 65 W ASSUMED figure is whole-package sustained draw under inference-shaped load. This measurement is GPU-domain only, so a GPU-alone mean above 65 W already proves the package assumption understates reality; a GPU-alone mean below 65 W is not evidence the package assumption is high, because CPU/DRAM/ANE/package overhead are excluded here.
vs_assumed_sustained_watts.viability_gate_implication: Supplier viability and contribution margins price energy cost from sustainedWattsByHWClass. Understating watts understates energy cost and can make an unprofitable cell look viable. This receipt is the bound GPU-energy authority; promoting it into the package table is a separate pricing-lane decision.
